mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in the month prior to the prediction is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discounting of future cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero when FEDFUNDS > 5.25%, p > 0.05

mechanism_narrative: When monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 50,000 jobs and unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 4%, it signals a strong labor market that depresses equity valuations, producing negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (t-test p < 0.05) under the same labor conditions

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) of at least 2% followed by a month of rising home sales (HOUST) predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals robust economic momentum.
failure_condition: No significant return difference over 20 days when both proxies show the pattern

mechanism_narrative: A decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 4% for two consecutive months predicts a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as it reduces discounting pressure on equities.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite CPIAUCSL < 4% for two months

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 3.5% for three consecutive months triggers a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it suggests economic resilience and lower risk premia.
failure_condition: No positive 20-day return when UNRATE remains below 3.5% for three months

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in retail sales (PAYEMS) and manufacturing activity (GDPC1) exceeding 2% each are associated with a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return due to over-optimistic demand expectations.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > +2% AND GDPC1 > +2% in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly negative when both proxies exceed +2%

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in monthly payrolls (PAYEMS) followed by a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) to below 4% in the next month predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals labor market balance.
failure_condition: No positive return when the pattern occurs but SPX underperforms

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 50th percentile indicates weak supply-side momentum, predicting a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not negative when INDPRO remains below 50th percentile for 3 months
